title: Direct prompt-row attention numerics mode (full-context online softmax, no partial states): verification and 5-pair qualification (Qwen3-4B, A100 GPU7)
registered: 2026-10-23 KST, before the GPU test and any serving arm of this experiment
user_decision: 2026-10-23: hold asynchronous submission; build a varlen prompt attention kernel for mixed steps as a new numerics mode, pre-registered and verified.
mode: RILEY_NATIVE_D128_PROMPT_DIRECT=1 (experiment selection by environment; a server flag follows only if adopted). Prompt rows: one CTA per (16-row tile, KV head) folds every page of the row's context with the existing prompt-row online softmax and writes BF16 outputs directly; the merge skips prompt rows. Decode rows unchanged (per-page tensor-core producer + global-max merge).

binaries.candidate: riley-phase1-v9 (sha recorded at build), same native-extra.json, environment RILEY_NATIVE_D128_PROMPT_DIRECT=1; burst, fused and segment modes off

gates.G1_gpu_unit_test: prompt_direct_attention_gpu passes for all 8 geometries at 20 and 120 pages: prompt-row bytes identical across run order, tile alignment (1-3 leading rows), generated-row list on/off, isolation and chunking into separate calls; decode rows byte-identical to the segment path; padding rows zero; max |direct - segment path| on prompt rows <= 0.03125
gates.G2_serving_invariance: candidate arms only: measured 192/192 equal to the candidate's own canonical outputs in every arm; no mismatch among its correctness outputs across fixed C1/C8/C16/C32 and natural C8/C32 (per-mode canonical sets)
gates.G3_hf_agreement: candidate HF token matches on the 15-prompt correctness set >= 11 of 15 per pass at every concurrency (C1 >= 11/15, C>1 >= 33/45)
gates.G4_primary_performance: natural C32: median-of-5 paired throughput change >= +2.0%
gates.G5_noninferiority: every cell: median-of-5 paired throughput change >= -1.3%, TPOT p50 change <= +1.5%, TPOT p99 change <= +10%

cells: fixed C1/C8/C16/C32 and natural C8/C32, 5 fresh pairs each, 64 warm + 192 measured, runner order alternation
reporting: All pairs and metrics including TTFT p50/p95/p99; measured-workload HF matches; share of measured outputs equal to the baseline mode's outputs (informational); nothing excluded or repeated; an aborted arm is preserved and continued under a new label
decision: All gates pass -> adopt as the recommended Qwen3-4B native prompt attention and add an explicit server flag; any gate fails -> keep the segment-state prompt path and record why
